summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the final detailed voting map from an extraordinary general stockholders' meeting held on April 28, 2026. The filing is a routine post-meeting report under CVM Resolution No. 81/22, listing votes on unspecified agenda items. No transaction, special event, or corporate action is announced. As a foreign issuer report of meeting results, it does not constitute a special situation requiring categorization.
